episodes.title: The Online Cult Targeting Aussie Kids
episodes.description:
There's an online group targeting Aussie kids inside their favourite games. 

Former WA detective Rebekah Nijsen breaks it down for Gary Jubelin. 

Rebekah spent almost two decades protecting kids and now runs Lighthouse Cyber Education. In this highlight, she explains how the group known as 764 finds kids in places like Fortnite, Roblox and Minecraft, then moves the conversation to private chats on Discord and Telegram.

She walks through how it starts, a friend request in a game, constant attention and messages, and how quickly it turns into pressure and control. Gary and Rebekah talk about why this age group is so vulnerable, the warning signs parents miss, and the simple steps families can take tonight around devices, privacy settings and open conversations.

This is a highlight from the full interview. Watch the full episodes here.
